choices.content: The number of items in the specified category in the population
The number of items in the population
The number of items remaining after the draw

question.prompt: In the hypergeometric mean formula \(nK/N\), what does \(K\) represent?

solutions.explanation: \(N\) is the number of items in the population, \(n\) is the number of items drawn, and \(K\) is the number of items in that category in the population.
solutions.title: Identify the formula parameters
